pairs.target: guāng àn xiàlái shí , lín zhào hái yǐwéi yòu yǒu yúnzhē guòqù le .
pairs.english: When the light dimmed, Lin Zhao still thought another cloud had passed across it.
pairs.hanzi: 光暗下来时，林照还以为又有云遮过去了。

pairs.target: tā děng zhe nà kuàishí miàn chóngxīn liàng qǐ , děng le xǔjiǔ , shuǐshàng de suì guāng què yípiànpiàn shōu méi le .
pairs.english: She waited for the stone surface to brighten again, waited a long while, but the scattered light on the water vanished piece by piece.
pairs.hanzi: 她等着那块石面重新亮起，等了许久，水上的碎光却一片片收没了。

pairs.target: duàn dǐng hòutou zhī shèng yìjiǎo shēnhuī , lián láishí nà kuài shíbǎn yě kànbùqīng .
pairs.english: Beyond the broken roof only a corner of deep gray remained; she couldn’t even make out the slab she’d come past.
pairs.hanzi: 断顶后头只剩一角深灰，连来时那块石板也看不清。

pairs.target: tā bǎ yāodài wǎng tuǐ biān lǒng jìn , shǒu pèng zhe shuǐnáng , cái shāoshāo dìng xiàlái .
pairs.english: She drew the waist pouch closer toward her legs; only when her hand touched the waterskin did she settle a little.
pairs.hanzi: 她把腰袋往腿边拢近，手碰着水囊，才稍稍定下来。

pairs.target: zhèlǐ méiyǒu dēng .
pairs.english: There was no lamp here.
pairs.hanzi: 这里没有灯。

pairs.target: zài wǎngqián nuó , lián luò shǒu de dìfāng dōu dé chóngxīn mō guò .
pairs.english: To go farther, she would have to feel out even the places to put her hands all over again.
pairs.hanzi: 再往前挪，连落手的地方都得重新摸过。

pairs.target: tā jiāng yījīn lā yán , méi gǎndòng yāo cè de bù .
pairs.english: She pulled her lapels tight and dared not disturb the cloth at her side.
pairs.hanzi: 她将衣襟拉严，没敢动腰侧的布。

pairs.target: bù biān lùchū de nà diǎn hóng yǐjīng fāàn , zhǐtou yā shàngqù , lǐmiàn què hái téng .
pairs.english: The speck of red showing at the cloth's edge had already darkened, but pressing a finger against it still hurt inside.
pairs.hanzi: 布边露出的那点红已经发暗，指头压上去，里面却还疼。

pairs.target: tā mànmàn shōuhuí shǒu , tiēzhe qiáng , jiāng liǎngtiáotuǐ quán jìn le xiē .
pairs.english: She slowly drew her hand back and, close against the wall, curled both legs a little nearer.
pairs.hanzi: 她慢慢收回手，贴着墙，将两条腿蜷近了些。

pairs.target: zuò zhe bǐ fāngcái bú nàme lěng , kě yí bìyǎn , nà jié wànzǐ biàn yòu cóng shíbǎn dǐxià táiqǐ lái .
pairs.english: Sitting was less cold than before, but whenever she closed her eyes, that wrist rose again from beneath the slab.
pairs.hanzi: 坐着比方才不那么冷，可一闭眼，那截腕子便又从石板底下抬起来。

pairs.target: tā zhēngkāiyǎn , zìjǐ de shǒu zhèng dā zài xī shàng .
pairs.english: She opened her eyes; her own hand was resting on her knee.
pairs.hanzi: 她睁开眼，自己的手正搭在膝上。

pairs.target: xǔ cén bǎshǒu àn zài shítou shàng , yě yǒu guò nàyàng dàn de guāng .
pairs.english: When Xu Cen pressed her hand to stone, there had also been that same faint light.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑把手按在石头上，也有过那样淡的光。

pairs.target: qī lán sōngkāi gōngxián , tā hái méi tīng qīng jiàn luò zài nǎér , nà zhī huī yǐng biàn bèi dìng huí le liáng shàng .
pairs.english: Qi Lan had loosed the bowstring; before she could hear where the arrow landed, that gray creature was already pinned back against the beam.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚松开弓弦，她还没听清箭落在哪儿，那只灰影便被钉回了梁上。

pairs.target: nàxiē shì tā dōu kànjiàn guò , xiānqián què zǒng juéde gé zhe shénme , lúnbúdào zìjǐ shēnshàng .
pairs.english: She had seen all those things before, yet had always felt something lay between them and her, as though it would never be her turn.
pairs.hanzi: 那些事她都看见过，先前却总觉得隔着什么，轮不到自己身上。

alignment.english: as though it would never be

pairs.target: nándào tā yě juéxǐng le ?
pairs.english: Could she have awakened too?
pairs.hanzi: 难道她也觉醒了？

pairs.target: zhège niàntou ràng tā de xīn měngtiào le jǐxià .
pairs.english: The thought made her heart pound sharply a few times.
pairs.hanzi: 这个念头让她的心猛跳了几下。

pairs.target: tā dītóu , shìtú kànqīng zìjǐ de zhǐjié , hēi lǐ què zhǐnéng biànchū yìdiǎn lúnkuò .
pairs.english: She lowered her head, trying to see her knuckles clearly, but could make out only a faint outline in the dark.
pairs.hanzi: 她低头，试图看清自己的指节，黑里却只能辨出一点轮廓。

pairs.target: ruò zhēnshì rúcǐ , fāngcái wèishénme yòu shénme dōu méi chūlái ?
pairs.english: If that was really so, why had nothing come out again just before?
pairs.hanzi: 若真是如此，方才为什么又什么都没出来？

pairs.target: nà jié shǒubì dàodǐ cóng nǎér lái de ?
pairs.english: Where on earth had that arm come from?
pairs.hanzi: 那截手臂到底从哪儿来的？

pairs.target: tā xiǎng le bàntiān , yě méi néng bǎ yíjiàn shì xiǎng míngbái .
pairs.english: She thought for a long time and couldn't make sense of even one thing.
pairs.hanzi: 她想了半天，也没能把一件事想明白。

pairs.target: yāo cè dǎo xiān téng qǐlái , bī dé tā huàn le gè zīshì , lián hūxī yě gēnzhe fàngqīng .
pairs.english: Instead her side began to hurt first, forcing her to shift position and, in turn, breathe even more softly.
pairs.hanzi: 腰侧倒先疼起来，逼得她换了个姿势，连呼吸也跟着放轻。

pairs.target: hòulái , lián nà yìjiǎo huī yě méi le .
pairs.english: Later, even that corner of gray was gone.
pairs.hanzi: 后来，连那一角灰也没了。

pairs.target: tā kàozhe qiáng , bǎ méi bāo bù de shǒu sāijìn xiùlǐ , zuàn zhù lìngyìbiān de xiùkǒu .
pairs.english: She leaned against the wall, slipped her unbandaged hand inside a sleeve and gripped the other cuff.
pairs.hanzi: 她靠着墙，把没包布的手塞进袖里，攥住另一边的袖口。

pairs.target: shībù tiēzhe pífū , tā xiānqián zhī juéde lěng , zhèshí què lěng dé yǒuxiē nǎo , fǎngfú zhǐyào bǎ nǎ yídào fèng lǒng yán , zhè yíyè jiù néng hǎo guò xiē .
pairs.english: Wet cloth lay against her skin; before she had only felt cold, but now the cold made her a little angry, as though closing any one gap tightly might make the night easier.
pairs.hanzi: 湿布贴着皮肤，她先前只觉得冷，这时却冷得有些恼，仿佛只要把哪一道缝拢严，这一夜就能好过些。

pairs.target: shuǐnáng zài tuǐ páng pèng le yíxià .
pairs.english: The waterskin bumped once against her leg.
pairs.hanzi: 水囊在腿旁碰了一下。

pairs.target: tā mō dào tā , nǐngkāi gài , hē le yìdiǎn , méi gǎn duō hē .
pairs.english: She felt for it, unscrewed the cap and drank a little, not daring to drink more.
pairs.hanzi: 她摸到它，拧开盖，喝了一点，没敢多喝。

pairs.target: dài lǐ de bǐng yòu shǎo le yìxiǎo kǒu , jiáo qǐlái méishénme wèi , dǎo yǒu yìkē chǎo dòu gǔnjìn zhǎngxīn .
pairs.english: Another small bite was gone from the flatbread in her pouch; as she chewed, it had little taste, but a roasted bean rolled into her palm.
pairs.hanzi: 袋里的饼又少了一小口，嚼起来没什么味，倒有一颗炒豆滚进掌心。

pairs.target: tā hán zhe nà kē dòuzǐ , mànmàn yǎo kāi , shéjiān cái chángdào yìdiǎn yán .
pairs.english: She held the bean in her mouth and slowly bit it open; only then did her tongue taste a little salt.
pairs.hanzi: 她含着那颗豆子，慢慢咬开，舌尖才尝到一点盐。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn tiāo dòu shí , zǒng xiāntiāo xiǎo de .
pairs.english: When Aunt Zhou picked beans, she always chose the small ones first.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶挑豆时，总先挑小的。

pairs.target: tā hūrán hěn xiǎng tīngjiàn zhōu shěn xián tā chī dé tàimàn , huòshì wèn tā xiédǐ yòu cèng huài le méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Suddenly she longed to hear Aunt Zhou complain that she ate too slowly, or ask whether she’d scuffed her soles again.
pairs.hanzi: 她忽然很想听见周婶嫌她吃得太慢，或是问她鞋底又蹭坏了没有。

pairs.target: huíqù yǐhòu , nǎpà nà jiān cháo dōng de fáng yǐjīng zūgěi biérén , yě méishénme .
pairs.english: After she got home, it still wouldn’t matter even if the east-facing room had already been rented to someone else.
pairs.hanzi: 回去以后，哪怕那间朝东的房已经租给别人，也没什么。

pairs.target: tā kěyǐ zài gēnzhe huò duì zǒu yítàng , jiàn bǎo de shì lìngxiǎngbànfǎ .
pairs.english: She could take another trip with a freight caravan; as for a reference, she could try something else.
pairs.hanzi: 她可以再跟着货队走一趟，荐保的事另想办法。

pairs.target: kě bié zài ràng tā xiě .
pairs.english: But she mustn't let him write it again.
pairs.hanzi: 可别再让他写。

pairs.target: tā jiāng shèngxià de dòuzǐ lǒng hǎo , tiēzhe dàikǒu mō le yíbiàn jié .
pairs.english: She gathered the remaining beans and felt along the pouch's mouth to check the knot once.
pairs.hanzi: 她将剩下的豆子拢好，贴着袋口摸了一遍结。

pairs.target: méiyǒu zài qù xiǎng nà zhāng zhǐ .
pairs.english: She didn't think about that paper again.
pairs.hanzi: 没有再去想那张纸。

pairs.target: zhè yíyè xiàng bèi shuǐshēng jié chéng xǔduō duàn .
pairs.english: The sound of water seemed to cut the night into many pieces.
pairs.hanzi: 这一夜像被水声截成许多段。

pairs.target: tā shí shuì shí xǐng , xǐnglái zǒng xiān mō shēnbiān de dōngxī .
pairs.english: She slept and woke by turns, always feeling for the things beside her first when she woke.
pairs.hanzi: 她时睡时醒，醒来总先摸身边的东西。

pairs.target: yǒu yìhuí tuǐ dǒu dé tíngbúzhù , tā biàn bǎ xīgài shōujǐn , guò le yízhèn yòu mànmàn fàngkāi .
pairs.english: Once her legs wouldn’t stop trembling; she then drew her knees close, and slowly let them relax after a while.
pairs.hanzi: 有一回腿抖得停不住，她便把膝盖收紧，过了一阵又慢慢放开。

pairs.target: shuǐ yǒushí xiǎng xiē , yǒushí qīng xiē , shǐzhōng méi màn dào kàoqiáng de zhè yìbiān .
pairs.english: Sometimes the water was louder, sometimes softer, but it never reached the side nearest the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 水有时响些，有时轻些，始终没漫到靠墙的这一边。

pairs.target: zài kànjiàn shídǐng shí , tā yìshí bùzhī nà shì shénme .
pairs.english: When she saw the stone roof again, she didn't know for a moment what it was.
pairs.hanzi: 再看见石顶时，她一时不知那是什么。

pairs.target: huībái de yíxiàn , mànmàn cóng quēkǒu lǐ tòuxiàlái .
pairs.english: A gray-white line slowly seeped down through the gap.
pairs.hanzi: 灰白的一线，慢慢从缺口里透下来。

pairs.target: tā dīng le piànkè , cái zhīdào tiān yòu liàng le .
pairs.english: She stared a moment before realizing day had come again.
pairs.hanzi: 她盯了片刻，才知道天又亮了。

pairs.target: shǒujiǎo xiàng yā zài biérén de shēnshàng , dòng yíxià , téng cái yíchù yichù zhǎo huílái .
pairs.english: Her hands and feet felt as if they lay on someone else’s body; when she moved, pain then found its way back, place by place.
pairs.hanzi: 手脚像压在别人的身上，动一下，疼才一处一处找回来。

pairs.target: shuǐnáng hái zài .
pairs.english: The waterskin was still there.
pairs.hanzi: 水囊还在。

pairs.target: yāodài yě zài .
pairs.english: The waist pouch was there too.
pairs.hanzi: 腰袋也在。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tāmen chóngxīn guàhuí bùdài , zuò zhe děng yǎnqián qīngchǔ xiē , cái fú qiáng qǐshēn .
pairs.english: She hung them back on the belt again, sat until her vision cleared a little, then rose with the wall’s support.
pairs.hanzi: 她把它们重新挂回布带，坐着等眼前清楚些，才扶墙起身。

pairs.target: yāo zhī zhí le yíbàn biàn tíngzhù le , hǎo zài liǎngzhī jiǎo dōu cǎi dào le shí shàng .
pairs.english: She stopped with her waist only half straightened; at least both feet were on stone.
pairs.hanzi: 腰只直了一半便停住了，好在两只脚都踩到了石上。

pairs.target: shòuyā de nà zhī jiǎo bùnéng duō yònglì , tā jiāng jiǎogēn wǎng lǐ shōu , yòng xīgài hé méi shāng de shǒu chēng zhe , xiān wǎngqián nuó le yíbù .
pairs.english: She couldn’t put much weight on the bruised foot; drawing her heel inward, she braced on her knee and uninjured hand, then moved one step forward.
pairs.hanzi: 受压的那只脚不能多用力，她将脚跟往里收，用膝盖和没伤的手撑着，先往前挪了一步。

pairs.target: dào le shí miàn jìntóu , shuǐshēng hūrán biàn le .
pairs.english: At the end of the stone surface, the sound of water suddenly changed.
pairs.hanzi: 到了石面尽头，水声忽然变了。

pairs.target: xiānqián shì shuǐ tiēzhe jiǎo biān guò , zhèlǐ què zài wǎng xiàluò .
pairs.english: Before, water had run beside her feet; here instead it was falling.
pairs.hanzi: 先前是水贴着脚边过，这里却在往下落。

pairs.target: lín zhào kàoqiáng dūn dī , shēnchū jiǎo shìleshì , qiántou de shí yán duàn le .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao crouched low against the wall and reached out a foot to test: the ledge ahead was broken.
pairs.hanzi: 林照靠墙蹲低，伸出脚试了试，前头的石沿断了。

pairs.target: dǐxià yǒu shuǐ , què kànbùqīng lí xié jiān duō yuǎn .
pairs.english: There was water below, but she couldn't see how far it lay from her toes.
pairs.hanzi: 底下有水，却看不清离鞋尖多远。

pairs.target: tā jiāng jiǎo shōuhuí lái , méi gǎn zài tàn .
pairs.english: She drew her foot back and dared not probe again.
pairs.hanzi: 她将脚收回来，没敢再探。

pairs.target: wǎnghuí wàng , zuóyè xiē guò de dìfāng hái kàndéjiàn .
pairs.english: Looking back, she could still see the place where she’d rested last night.
pairs.hanzi: 往回望，昨夜歇过的地方还看得见。

pairs.target: tā cóng qiánggēn jiǎn le sānkē xiǎoshí , pái zài shēn cè , miǎnde huítóu yòu mō dào duànkǒu shàng .
pairs.english: She picked up three small stones from the foot of the wall and lined them beside her, so she wouldn’t feel her way onto the broken edge again on returning.
pairs.hanzi: 她从墙根捡了三颗小石，排在身侧，免得回头又摸到断口上。

pairs.target: zài tái yǎn , cái fāxiàn qiáng zài duànkǒu pángbiān fēnkāi le :
pairs.english: Only when she looked up again did she notice the wall divided beside the break:
pairs.hanzi: 再抬眼，才发现墙在断口旁边分开了：

pairs.target: shuǐ cóng dī chù zuānjìn yídào héng cáo , pángbiān què liú zhe bàn rén gāo de zhǎi kǒu , dǐxià yě yǒu shí , zhǐshì bǐ zhèbiān gāo le yì zhǎng .
pairs.english: the water entered a crosswise channel low down, but beside it was a narrow opening half a person’s height, with stone underneath too, just a palm higher than on this side.
pairs.hanzi: 水从低处钻进一道横槽，旁边却留着半人高的窄口，底下也有石，只是比这边高了一掌。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu lìkè pá guòqù .
pairs.english: She didn't crawl over at once.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有立刻爬过去。

pairs.target: zhǎi kǒulǐ bújiàn shuǐ guāng .
pairs.english: There was no gleam of water in the opening.
pairs.hanzi: 窄口里不见水光。

pairs.target: tā tiēzhe qiáng kàn , xiùkǒu yìgēn sōng xiàn què qīngqīng yáng qǐlái , pèngshàng shǒubèi , yòu piānxiàng shēnhòu .
pairs.english: She looked close against the wall, but a loose thread at her cuff lifted softly, touched the back of her hand, then leaned behind her.
pairs.hanzi: 她贴着墙看，袖口一根松线却轻轻扬起来，碰上手背，又偏向身后。

pairs.target: tā bǎshǒu nuókāi , xiàn réng cháo zhè yìbiān bǎi .
pairs.english: She moved her hand away; the thread still swayed toward her.
pairs.hanzi: 她把手挪开，线仍朝这一边摆。

pairs.target: nàlǐ yǒu fēng .
pairs.english: There was air moving there.
pairs.hanzi: 那里有风。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ huòzhàn hòutou nà dào xiǎomén .
pairs.english: She remembered the little gate behind the freight depot.
pairs.hanzi: 她想起货栈后头那道小门。

pairs.target: mén guān zhe shí , dōngtiān yě néng cóng ménfèng lǐ zuānjìn lěngqì , mén hòu què búshì lù , shì biérén jiā de yuànzi .
pairs.english: Even with the gate shut, cold air could slip through the crack in winter, but behind it was someone else’s courtyard rather than a road.
pairs.hanzi: 门关着时，冬天也能从门缝里钻进冷气，门后却不是路，是别人家的院子。

pairs.target: yǒu fēng , wèibì jiù néng chūqù .
pairs.english: A draft did not necessarily mean a way out.
pairs.hanzi: 有风，未必就能出去。

pairs.target: kě qiántou de shuǐ yǐjīng méi le néng luòjiǎo de dìfāng .
pairs.english: But along the water ahead, there was no longer any place to set her feet.
pairs.hanzi: 可前头的水已经没了能落脚的地方。

pairs.target: lín zhào mànmàn cè guò shēn , xiān bǎ shuǐnáng hé yāodài jiě xià , fàngdào zhǎi kǒulǐ kàoqiáng de shí miànshàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao slowly turned sideways, first untied the waterskin and waist pouch, and set them on the stone inside the opening by the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 林照慢慢侧过身，先把水囊和腰袋解下，放到窄口里靠墙的石面上。

pairs.target: tā yā le yā nà kuàishí , méiyǒu sōng , cái bǎ xīgài nuó guòqù .
pairs.english: She pressed the stone; it didn’t move, and only then did she shift her knee over.
pairs.hanzi: 她压了压那块石，没有松，才把膝盖挪过去。

pairs.target: yījīn cā zhe shí biān , bùdài de jié kǎ le yíxià , tā tíngzhù , mō zhe bǎ tā yíkāi .
pairs.english: Her lapel brushed the stone edge and the belt knot caught once; she stopped and felt it free.
pairs.hanzi: 衣襟擦着石边，布带的结卡了一下，她停住，摸着把它移开。

pairs.target: zhǎi kǒu hòutou réng shì hēi de .
pairs.english: Beyond the opening it was still dark.
pairs.hanzi: 窄口后头仍是黑的。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu wǎng hēi lǐ zhí zǒu , xiān kào nèiqiáng zuòxià , chuǎn yún le qì , jiāng jiǎo yìdiǎndiǎn shēnchū qù .
pairs.english: She didn't head straight into the dark; first she sat by the inner wall, steadied her breathing and extended her foot little by little.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有往黑里直走，先靠内墙坐下，喘匀了气，将脚一点点伸出去。

pairs.target: jiǎogēn pèngdào shíchù , tā cái bǎ shēnzi wǎngqián sòng .
pairs.english: Only when her heel met firm ground did she ease her body forward.
pairs.hanzi: 脚跟碰到实处，她才把身子往前送。

pairs.target: bèihòu háiyǒu shuǐ luòxiàqù de xiǎngshēng .
pairs.english: The sound of falling water was still behind her.
pairs.hanzi: 背后还有水落下去的响声。

pairs.target: qiánmiàn què yǒu yìxiǎo zhènfēng , tiēzhe tā de liǎn , mànmàn chuīguòlái .
pairs.english: But ahead there was a little draft brushing her face, slowly blowing toward her.
pairs.hanzi: 前面却有一小阵风，贴着她的脸，慢慢吹过来。
